title: B1 & B6 full 5-port end-to-end loopback conformance test and Optional::signed_udp_pong_prefix enforcement
goal: Promote signed_udp_pong_prefix into susi_conformance::Optional and enforce prefix matching directly inside udp_discovery_signed, wire --signed-udp-pong-prefix in the susi-conformance CLI, and add full_suite_run_with_passes_across_all_five_contract_ports_at_shared_offset exercising run_with end-to-end across all 5 contract ports (9090 MCP, 9091 GEMI, 9092 UDP_DISCOVERY, 9093 MCP_ALIAS, 9094 A2A) at a shared port_offset (B1, B6; landed in 3a2354ae6 #1388).

reuse.reason: Extended existing susi_conformance::Optional, udp_discovery_signed, CLI flag parser, and loopback test fixtures in crates/susi-conformance (landed in squash commit 3a2354ae6133186565d54135ddd5f45156e18d6d #1388) without introducing new crates or external dependencies.
